scores.evidence: Re-scored because sc-quiz and check-quiz changed. Only q4's hint (「点検リストのどの分野の問題かを、まず考えましょう。」) and one e3 feedback changed. Their stems, options, answers, objectiveId (o2) and bloom (evaluate) did not. o1 is still assessed by q1, q2, e1 and e2, and o2 by q3, q4 and e3. o1 is performed in practice-setup.

hook-b1 is a concrete 3-sentence scenario (「初日にスキル（skill）5つとフック（hook）3つを一度に入れようとして、手が止まりました」) and is followed by the ungraded pq0. pq0's explanation now states the day-1 exception (「ただし、秘密情報とpushの守りは例外で、初日から置きます」), so the rule no longer contradicts the example.

Re-scored because the lesson now belongs to course claude-code. Each prerequisite matches a lesson title in content/courses/claude-code/course.json exactly (for example 「第3回｜探索→計画→実装→コミット」 and 「第10回｜安全とコストを管理する」). The lesson-number references in dr-table (「（第6回）」, 「（subagent、第7回）」, 「（第8回）」) match the course order too. dr-table still links each part to the lesson that taught it, and every katakana part is glossed on first use.

Re-measured. measure.mjs gives 「prose 1344 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 1894 · practice reading 1672 · questions 8 · practice sections 3 · est 19.3 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」. estMinutes 19 matches the rounded estimate and the course.json entry (19). lint --strict shows 0 errors and 0 warnings. Only courseId changed, so the text load is the same.

Re-scored because ex-prompt-skill changed. Its expect now explains every non-obvious line of the skill the learner copies: allowed-tools (「スキルを呼んでから次に入力するまで、確認なしで使えます」), the `!` injection, and /reload-skills. That improves the example. ex-steps still have subgoal titles, a trigger and an expect, and they come before practice. There is still no faded step between the full example and independent practice.

Re-scored because sc-quiz and check-quiz changed. 4 of the 5 content sections still end in an inline check (q1–q4), and never 2 sections in a row go without one. q4's hint now names the same 分野 that sc-b1 and the self-check-list title use. It points to an area without giving away the option.

Re-scored because e3 changed. e3 a's feedback still names the misconception (cutting a CLAUDE.md that is already short) and gives the reason: 「40行は、公式の目安（200行未満）に収まっています。今の穴は、完了を確かめる手段がないことです。」. The other feedback is unchanged, each 2 sentences or fewer with a reason, and all 7 misconceptions in the brief map to distractors.

Re-scored for the changed table. dr-table is still a real 2-column comparison table, with 5 rows that pair a repeated problem with a part (for example 「横道の調べもので会話が埋まる」 → 「[[サブエージェント]]（subagent、第7回）」). The restored gloss makes one cell slightly longer but keeps the table at 2 columns. cycle-flow is unchanged: 5 nodes plus the review loop, with caption and alt. There are no decorative images.

Re-scored because sc-b1 (in the self-check practice section) changed. The lead now names the same four areas as the checklist (「安全・検証・コンテキスト・コストの4分野で点検します」), so the learner can see how self-check-list is organised before using it as the success checklist. Every step has an expect, and the model answers come after the hints. c-review and c-commit still have no hint or troubleshoot, so the hint ladder is incomplete.

Re-scored because the lesson is now the last lesson of the published course. summary-next's 「これで全11回は終わりです。次は、演習3で決めた部品を足していきましょう。」 matches course.json, where module m4 has 11 lessons in all and cc-11-capstone is last with no next link, so the closing does not point to a missing lesson. The summary still comes after the exam, with 4 points (point 4: 「安全・検証・コンテキスト・コストの4分野で点検し、次に足すものを決めます。」), a reflection prompt, 7 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

Re-scored for the changed claims. e3 a's 「200行未満」 matches facts-cc-11-capstone.md (「Aim for under 200 lines per file」) and cc-06. ex-prompt-skill's 「スキルを呼んでから次に入力するまで、確認なしで使えます」 matches factbase.md docs-25 (「`allowed-tools`: pre-approved tools for the turn that invokes the skill」), and the block cites cc-skills. The earlier fixes (the ex-claude-md restart, the ex-rules auto-mode scope, the ex-hook command) are unchanged.

Re-scored for the changed text. It keeps です・ます and a calm tone (「確認なしで使えます」; 「4分野で点検します」). sc-b1, the q4 hint and summary point 4 now use 分野 throughout, with no leftover 観点 (grep finds none). That keeps the course's terms apart from cc-03's glossary term 「4つの観点」. lint finds no banned phrase.

Re-scored for the changed table. dr-table's caption, headers and the restored cell are plain text, apart from the glossary link that the other rows also use (「[[サブエージェント]]（subagent、第7回）」). That suits fields that render without markdown. The table keeps 2 real header cells for screen readers. cycle-flow's alt text is complete, and the jp locale is complete.

niceToHave: Factual doubt: ex-prompt-skill's 「確認なしで使えます」 could be read as allowed-tools overriding the deny and ask rules that ex-rules just set. facts-cc-11-capstone.md says an allow 「cannot carve an exception out of a deny」, and the changelog fixed managed ask rules 「being bypassed by … skill allowed-tools」. Check this against cc-skills. If it holds, add after the sentence: 「拒否ルールは、それでも優先されます。」
sc-b1 calls an unmet checklist item a きっかけ, while the glossary defines きっかけ as 「同じ困りごとが繰り返し起きること」. Change 「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すもののきっかけです。」 to 「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すものの候補です。」
dr-table row 1 has no verb (「CLAUDE.mdに1行（第6回）」), while the next rows name whole parts. For a clear action, change it to 「CLAUDE.mdに1行足す（第6回）」.
c-review (cycle-steps) has no hint or troubleshoot. Add the hint 「指摘が多すぎたら、計画の要件に関わるものだけに絞ってと頼みます。」
c-commit (cycle-steps) has no hint. Add the hint 「1行目が長すぎたら、「何を変えたかを1行目に50字以内で」と頼みます。」
p-claude-md's 「25行以内」 is unexplained, while e3 a's feedback calls 40 lines fine under the official 200-line guide (「200行未満」). Change p-claude-md's hint to 「最初は25行以内を目安にします。各行に「消したらまちがえる？」と聞きます。」

worked (to reach 4): add a faded step before practice-setup. For example, add a question where the learner picks the part for ③ before seeing it, or leave one ex-steps item's md for the learner to complete.
summary: Verification round: review-scope exited 0. Only lesson.courseId changed (vibe-coding → claude-code, 1 of 71 parts, 2%), and no block, section or objective changed. The previous rounds left no open must-fix, so there are no resolved entries. I checked the change against content/courses/claude-code/course.json. The lesson title, estMinutes 19, the prerequisite titles, the 第n回 references and summary-next's 「全11回は終わりです」 all match the course, where cc-11-capstone is the last lesson with no next link. I found no regression. validate shows 0 errors and lint --strict shows 0 errors and 0 warnings. measure.mjs gives prose 1344 and est 19.3 min, against estMinutes 19. I re-scored prior, load and meta and carried over the other 10 criteria. Every criterion is 3 or higher and the mean is 3.85, so the verdict is pass. The niceToHave items are the same as in the previous round.
